title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky — Episode8 One Step Forward

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Event Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Well, good day to you, my clumsy hunter.”

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A (As Rio)
rows.Line: “Thanks for helping me deal with that witch. I really appreciate it, Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A (As Rio)
rows.Line:
“For now, farewell!
I promise to visit your forest again someday!”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: That wasn't bad. Your portrayal's improved quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This audition is based on three-minute segments of scenes that each candidate wishes to do...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Therefore, which scene one chooses will prove crucial...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suspect he's already made his choice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu...
Are you sure you don't want to lie down for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Emu?
Are you not feeling...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... My chest is starting to feel super tight because Tsukasa's going really soon...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's rare for you to be so anxious...
You hardly ever feel nervous even when we're about to perform at a big venue.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I think I know how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa... He worked himself until he was torn to shreds. So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should believe in our leader.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That'll be me, Tsukasa Tenma!
Thank you for this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: So, which scene would you like to do...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, page seventy-eight of the script...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The scene where Rio falls into deep despair after letting his final chance to catch the phoenix slip through his fingers...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (Yes, it's his big scene just before the climax.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (But it's also the most demanding one at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Then, let's begin.
Sakurako, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope we do well, Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Of course.
Do your best for me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (This is nothing like what Tenma's been doing until now... And it only took him an instant to create this tense atmosphere...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Mom is going to die when the sun sets today...! That's what the witch said!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “She said it's unavoidable if I don't deliver your heart to her!”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
(I see...
He must've worked very hard.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“I am here.
Right in front of you.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I enjoyed being chased by you very much these past few days. It is the most fun I have had in a very long time...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“So, come hither.
Take my heart from me!”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“They must be exhausted...
You have been running around this forest for several days straight.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I suspect you will not be able to catch me now...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's rising above the forest and into the sky. Along with the heart I've been chasing after...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I need to catch her...
I know that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why...?!
Why?! Why?! Why am I so...?!”

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line:
Oh...
Um... Isn't this where they're supposed to stop?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, you're right...
If the next person will...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That should've been the end of the scene. They're gonna keep going...?!)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I can finally have some peace and quiet now.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I doubt I will encounter another child bent on catching a phoenix with but a silly net.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“...
Hehe. What a strange turn of events.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Until just a moment ago, I was willing to give him my heart. But I ended up choosing life instead.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “You made me want to keep on living a little bit longer.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You decided that you couldn't leave Tsukasa's Rio be.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“...?
Something just fell from the sky... Is this...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“A phoenix feather...?
These are supposed to have the power to cure wounds and diseases...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Yes...
You... You were always so mean, but also kind...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You were willing to become my very first friend...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Your Rio was marvelous.
I couldn't help but want to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
To be honest, I was so desperate to get into Rio's mindset that I have no idea how well I did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I couldn't be happier hearing what you just said, Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Oh? It's not just me, you know?
Take a look out at the seats.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Are there any of you who believe you can top that performance...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Our boy, Rio, will be played by Tsukasa Tenma of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I look forward to working with you more starting today, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Now that we know you'll be playing my counterpart, get ready for some even tougher practices...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm ready for that!
I, Tsukasa Tenma, will take on whatever trials are thrown my way!!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe... That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Our star is shining so brightly...
I think I'm starting to tear up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In order to allow this star to shine high in the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I believe it's time for me to act...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to show just how much I appreciate them. I wouldn't have been able to do this without them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was able to grow because they were willing to believe in me and give me their support.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Above me are thousands...
No, tens of thousands of actors.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Where I'm trying to go is far over the horizon, and I have no idea if or when I'll get there.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It doesn't matter that I don't know when or if I'll be able to reach it. The path I must take remains the same.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: To think that he could grow this much in such a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The 30th Anniversary Show is shaping up to be a truly great one.
